title: Retractions by Alternating Projections
summary: Alternating projections and their variants are classical tools for computing points in intersections of sets. Existing analyses for smooth manifolds mainly focus on local convergence rates under transversality or related regularity conditions. In this work, we develop a unified framework for a broad class of (possibly inexact) alternating-projection-type methods on intersections of smooth manifolds.
